Several '''Circarpous resistance''' groups opposed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As of [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] these groups were underground, as the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous system]] was unwilling to openly support the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Alliance to Restore the Republic established a [[Rebel base (Circarpous XIV)|secret base]] on [[Circarpous XIV]], and organized a secret [[Conference with the Circarpousian underground|Conference on Circarpous IV]] in the hopes of supporting the underground resistance movements and coaxing the system into declaring open support for the Rebellion.
